The '''Dantooine Space Station''', or simply '''Dantooine Station''', was a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] in the [[Dantooine system/Legends|Dantooine system]]. It was used to provide emergency repairs for [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]], or clear them for landing at any of [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine's]] outposts. Indeed, following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], rumors of an [[Dantooine base/Legends|abandoned Rebel base]] has attracted many travelers and organizations on Dantooine.
